NIA arrests suspect in Manipur IED attack that killed two children

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested the first accused in the Tronglaobi IED attack in Manipur, which resulted in the deaths of two children. The arrested individual has been identified as the 'finance head' of the United Kuki National Army (UKNA). The suspect was taken into police custody following the arrest. The NIA is investigating the IED blast case.
